shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat ../ticket.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'if test -f ../round-brief.md; then cat ../round-brief.md; fi'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n "onError|Status|validated by|VALIDATED_BY" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts CHANGELOG.md && cat package.json'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,205p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,200p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,70p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:|SPEC\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -80 && rg --files scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md|specs/.+#[0-9]+|spec-anchor|spec:\" src scripts | head -100 && ls scripts | rg 'reanchor|spec' && git branch --show-current && git status --porcelain"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^[:space:]"'"\\x27]+#[0-9]+' src | head -30; sed -n '1,100p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,130p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs; sed -n '270,320p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ )]+#[0-9]+|@spec|spec-anchor'"' --glob '*test.ts' | head -80; rg -n 'statement|ordinal|spec' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs .lore/test-commands.yml | head -50; rg -n '"'^-'"' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts | head -15; sed -n '1,35p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '50,66p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts | head -12 && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '52,65p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts | sed -n '5,9p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts && git commit -m 'Call onError for non-Error rejections'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD'
